subject: Aligning senior sponsors & EB cadence for MAP delivery (Q1 close plan)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning senior sponsors & EB cadence for MAP delivery (Q1 close plan)

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion I’m attaching a working Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the evaluation plan that maps the technical checkpoints to commercial milestones. The goal here is to lock in a short, practical EB (executive briefing) cadence so Acme’s execs and our sponsors can run the evaluation without surprises and meet the target decision milestone in mid-Jan.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm who will be the formal executive sponsor(s) from Acme (name + role)?
- Suggested EB windows (pick one): Dec 8–10, Dec 14–16, or Jan 4–6 — each with a 60–75 minute slot.
- Please confirm any mandatory attendees (procurement, security, VP product, CTO).

Attached: MAP_Q1_close_v1.xlsx (milestones + owners), EvaluationPlan_v2.pdf (test cases + pass criteria), EB_onepager_draft.docx (one-slide ask for execs). I’ll roll the MAP to track owners and dates once we have sponsor names.

Proposed decision milestone: 2027-01-15 (contract signature / procurement coms). If that needs to move, call it out and we’ll rebaseline the MAP.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a concrete EB date once I hear back.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0173

Attachments: MAP_Q1_close_v1.xlsx (xlsx), EvaluationPlan_v2.pdf (pdf), EB_onepager_draft.docx (docx)

From: Maya Singh <maya@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning senior sponsors & EB cadence for MAP delivery (Q1 close plan)

Ben —

Appreciate the summary and the attachments. High level: we like the approach and the milestone cadence. A couple quick notes:

- Executive sponsors: Ravi Patel (CTO) and Elena Torres (VP Product) are the likely execs; Ravi will be the primary sponsor. I’ll confirm availability early next week.
- Mandatory: procurement will need a short slot (15–20min) in the EB to confirm contracting timeline. Security wants a separate 30m deep-dive but we can include a 10–15min overview in the EB and schedule the deep-dive after.
- EB windows: Dec 8–10 works best for Ravi; Dec 9 looks promising.

Can you share a one-page summary specifically tailored to execs (the current onepager is a bit technical). Also share a proposed internal RB (who speaks to reliability/cost, who owns procurement asks).

I’ll loop procurement on the calendar once we have a firm EB date.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Director, Platform Strategy | Acme Corp
maya@acme.com | +1 212-555-0134
